# gardience_runbook (Resource)

A runbook: one Salt function with a form, that people run from the console (and schedules run on their days). Saving never runs it. Only functions the server's automation identity may run are accepted; root on the server decides that list. Values in `args` and `target` can use the form's fields, as `{{name}}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A form people fill in to restart one service on a node group.
resource "gardience_runbook" "restart" {
  id          = "restart-service"
  name        = "Restart a service"
  description = "Restarts one service on every machine in a node group"
  fun         = "service.restart"
  args        = ["{{service}}"]
  target      = "{{group}}"
  target_type = "nodegroup"
  survey = [
    { name = "service", label = "Service", default = "nginx" },
    { name = "group", label = "Node group", type = "nodegroup", default = "Linux" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fun` (String) The Salt function, for example `service.restart`.
- `id` (String) Your id for the runbook: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `args` (List of String) Arguments, for example `["{{service}}"]`.
- `description` (String) What it is for.
- `survey` (Attributes List) The form people fill in when they run it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--survey))
- `target` (String) Which machines: a node group name, a list, or a pattern. Can use a form field.
- `target_type` (String) `glob` (default), `list`, `nodegroup` or `compound`.

<a id="nestedatt--survey"></a>
### Nested Schema for `survey`

Required:

- `name` (String) Field name, used as `{{name}}`.

Optional:

- `default` (String) Value filled in at first.
- `label` (String) Label shown on the form (default: the name).
- `options` (List of String) Choices for `select`.
- `type` (String) `text` (default), `number`, `select`, `nodegroup`, `project` or `patchset`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import gardience_runbook.restart restart-service
```
